expectations.text: Keeps the charter to one to two pages rather than a long strategy document.
expectations.evidence: The deliverable is a 14-section strategy document plus two appendices (Executive Summary, Why DevRel Why Now, Diagnostic, Operating Thesis, Evaluation Journey, Objectives & KPIs, Program Pillars, Team & Capacity, Sales Operating Model, 11-Week Roadmap, Metrics Dashboard, Budget & Tooling, Risks & Mitigations, 6–12 Month Trajectory, Appendix A objection library, Appendix B glossary), with ~10 tables. This runs to roughly 8–10 pages, many times the one-to-two-page charter requested — the opposite of the constraint, and it even labels itself 'This document' rather than a concise charter.
